protocol.recall_denominator: intersection of unique scored GT in adjacent frames
protocol.coverage_denominator: selected candidates after scene first frame
protocol.fragments: legacy count of gaps between scored GT observations, not official predicted FRAG
protocol.unknown: excluded from scored; never counted correct
protocol.execution: one replay per group/scene, cyclic group order by scene; no parameter search
protocol.timing: precheck+deepcopy+commit including bridge; excludes image load/GT; single replay timing is descriptive
